sources_considered.why: Primary contemporaneous industry assessment documenting growing integration, partnerships and dependence on cloud computing.
Read as corroboration; the underlying report provides the more complete evidence and qualifications.
Read, but the 2024 CMA report gives a cleaner contemporaneous basis without mixing later partnership developments into this observation.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph 43; related findings in paragraphs 15, 21–23 and 42–44
evidence_items.explanation: The report identifies increasing integration and partnerships involving Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, Apple and Nvidia, alongside developers' reliance on cloud computing. This supports the ordinary dependence reading, while the report also recognizes that partnerships can help independent developers and improve competition.

unresolved_gaps: The report does not measure how financial losses would be distributed in a hypothetical industry downturn.
It does not quantify Apple's role relative to every other named firm.
